question: Bharat ka Samvidhan kab lagoo hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Samvidhan 26 Nov 1949 ko apnaya gaya aur 26 Jan 1950 ko lagoo hua; isiliye 26 Jan ko Republic Day manate hain. | Galat kyun: 26 Nov 1949 apnane ki tareekh hai, lagoo hone ki nahi; 15 Aug 1947 swatantrata hai; 26 Jan 1949 galat varsh hai. | Concept: Apnana (adopt) aur lagoo hona (enforce) alag hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 26 Nov apnaya, 26 Jan lagoo — ek hi tareekh (26), alag kaam. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Samvidhan ki Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh kaun the?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Drafting Committee ke adhyaksh Dr B.R. Ambedkar the. | Galat kyun: Dr Rajendra Prasad Samvidhan Sabha ke adhyaksh the (Drafting Committee ke nahi); Patel aur Nehru kisi samiti ke adhyaksh nahi the. | Concept: Samvidhan Sabha (adhyaksh: Rajendra Prasad) vs Drafting Committee (adhyaksh: Ambedkar). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Drafting = Ambedkar; Sabha = Rajendra Prasad. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: 42nd Amendment (1976) se Prastavana me kaun se shabd jode gaye?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 42nd Amendment (1976) se Prastavana me 'Socialist, Secular, Integrity' jode gaye. | Galat kyun: Sovereign, Democratic, Republic pehle se Prastavana me the; Justice, Liberty bhi pehle se the. | Concept: 42nd Amendment ko 'Mini Constitution' kaha jata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 42nd = S-S-I (Socialist, Secular, Integrity). | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Anuchhed 32 ko kisne 'Samvidhan ki aatma' kaha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Dr B.R. Ambedkar ne Anuchhed 32 ko 'Samvidhan ki aatma' kaha, kyunki yah Fundamental Rights ko lagu karane ka adhikar deta hai. | Galat kyun: Gandhi, Nehru, Patel ne yah upma nahi di. | Concept: Art 32 — Samvaidhanik Upchar ka Adhikar (Supreme Court me seedhe jane ka adhikar). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Art 32 = aatma; bina iske adhikar kagaz par hi reh jate. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Matdan ki aayu 21 se 18 varsh kab ki gayi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 61st Amendment (1989) se matdan ki aayu 21 se 18 varsh hui. | Galat kyun: 42nd (1976) Preamble/FD se hai; 44th (1978) sampatti ke adhikar se; 52nd (1985) dal-badal se. | Concept: Sanshodhan aur uska vishay ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 61st = 18 saal. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: GST kis amendment se lagoo hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 101st Amendment (2016) se GST lagoo hua; isse desh bhar me ek kar vyavastha bani. | Galat kyun: 100th (2015) Bharat-Bangladesh bhu-sima se hai; 103rd (2019) EWS aarakshan se; 106th (2023) mahila aarakshan se. | Concept: GST = 'One Nation, One Tax'. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: GST = 101st (2016). | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha me kul kitni seatein hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha me 200 seatein hain. | Galat kyun: 150, 180 aur 250 kisi aur rajya ya sadan ki sankhya hain; Rajasthan ke liye 200 hi sahi hai. | Concept: Rajya Vidhan Sabha ki seat sankhya har rajya me alag hoti hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 200/25/10 — Vidhan Sabha 200, Lok Sabha 25, Rajya Sabha 10. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan se Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ki seatein kitni hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Rajasthan se Lok Sabha 25 aur Rajya Sabha 10 seatein hain. | Galat kyun: 30/12, 20/8 aur 25/12 galat jode hain; Lok Sabha 25 sahi hai par Rajya Sabha 12 nahi. | Concept: Sansad me rajya ka pratinidhitva jansankhya par nirbhar karta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 200/25/10 — ek hi mala. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Panchayati Raj ka udghatan Bharat me pehli baar kahan hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 2 Oct 1959 ko Nagaur (Rajasthan) me pehli baar Panchayati Raj ka udghatan PM Nehru ne kiya; Rajasthan iska janm-sthan hai. | Galat kyun: Udaipur/Jaipur me udghatan nahi hua; 26 Jan 1950 aur 15 Aug 1947 alag aitihasik tareekhein hain. | Concept: Panchayati Raj ki shuruaat Rajasthan se hui. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 2 Oct 1959, Nagaur — Gandhi jayanti par Panchayati Raj. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: 73rd Amendment kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 73rd Amendment (1992) ne Panchayati Raj ko samvaidhanik darja diya (11th Schedule, 29 vishay). | Galat kyun: 74th Nagarpalika se hai; mahila aarakshan aur GST alag vishay hain. | Concept: 73rd = gaon (Panchayat), 74th = shahar (Nagarpalika). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 73 gaon, 74 shahar. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Panchayati Raj ki 3-tier vyavastha me beech ka star kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 3-tier vyavastha: Gram Panchayat (gaon) → Panchayat Samiti (block, beech) → Zila Parishad (zila). | Galat kyun: Gram Panchayat sabse neeche hai; Zila Parishad sabse upar; Gram Sabha koi star nahi, gaon ke sabhi matdataon ki sabha hai. | Concept: Neeche se upar: gaon → block → zila. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: G-P-Z: Gaon, Panchayat Samiti, Zila. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) ne kis ki sifarish ki?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) ne 3-tier Panchayati Raj ki sifarish ki. | Galat kyun: 2-tier ki sifarish Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) ne ki thi; GST aur mahila aarakshan is samiti se nahi jude. | Concept: Balwant Rai Mehta = 3-tier; Ashok Mehta = 2-tier. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Balwant = 3, Ashok = 2. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Rajasthan High Court ki mukhya peeth kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Rajasthan High Court ki mukhya peeth Jodhpur me hai; Jaipur me bench hai. | Galat kyun: Jaipur bench hai, mukhya peeth nahi; Udaipur aur Ajmer me peeth nahi hai. | Concept: Mukhya peeth vs bench alag hote hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: High Court = Jodhpur (mukhya), Jaipur (bench). | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Rajasthan ke Mukhyamantri (Nov 2026) kaun hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Bhajan Lal Sharma Dec 2023 se Rajasthan ke CM hain (Nov 2026 tak). | Galat kyun: Ashok Gehlot pehle CM the (Dec 2023 tak); Vasundhara Raje pehle CM rahi hain; Sachin Pilot CM kabhi nahi bane. | Concept: Vartaman padadhikari ko pehle padadhikari se alag rakho; exam se pehle dobara check karo. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Dec 2023 se Bhajan Lal Sharma. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; notes/09_current_affairs.md.

question: Rajasthan ke Rajyapal (Nov 2026) kaun hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Haribhau Bagade July 2024 se Rajasthan ke Governor hain. | Galat kyun: Kalraj Mishra pehle Governor the; C.P. Radhakrishnan Maharashtra ke Governor the, phir Up-Rashtrapati bane; Gulab Chand Kataria Assam ke Governor hain. | Concept: Governor ki niyukti Rashtrapati karta hai; har rajya ka alag Governor hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: July 2024 se Bagade. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Anuchhed 21 kis adhikar se sambandhit hai?
option_d: Jeevan aur vyaktigat swatantrata ka adhikar
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Anuchhed 21 jeevan aur vyaktigat swatantrata ka adhikar deta hai. | Galat kyun: Samanata Art 14 hai; dharm ki swatantrata Art 25–28 hai; shiksha ka adhikar Art 21A hai. | Concept: Har Fundamental Right ka apna anuchhed hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 14 = Samanata, 19 = Swatantrata, 21 = Jeevan, 32 = Upchar. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Fundamental Duties kis amendment se jode gaye?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Fundamental Duties (Part IV-A, Art 51A) 42nd Amendment (1976) se jode gaye; 11th duty 86th Amendment (2002) se aayi. | Galat kyun: 86th ne sirf 11th duty jodi, Duties ki shuruaat nahi ki; 44th aur 52nd ka Duties se sambandh nahi. | Concept: Duties 1976 me aaye, 11th duty 2002 me. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 42nd = Duties ki shuruaat; 86th = 11th duty. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Sampatti ka adhikar Fundamental Right se kab hataya gaya?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 44th Amendment (1978) se sampatti ka adhikar Fundamental Right se hatakar kanuni adhikar (Art 300A) bana. | Galat kyun: 42nd ne Duties jode; 52nd dal-badal se hai; 61st matdan aayu se. | Concept: Sampatti ab FR nahi, kanuni adhikar hai — isliye is par Art 32 lagu nahi hota. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 44th ne sampatti ko FR se bahar kiya. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Nari Shakti Vandan (mahila aarakshan) kis amendment se hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 106th Amendment (2023), Nari Shakti Vandan, se Lok Sabha aur Vidhan Sabha me mahilaon ko 1/3 aarakshan mila. | Galat kyun: 73rd Panchayati Raj se hai; 101st GST se; 103rd EWS se. | Concept: Sanshodhan aur uska vishay ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 106th (2023) = Nari Shakti Vandan, 1/3. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: RPSC ka mukhyalaya kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — RPSC ka mukhyalaya Ajmer me hai (sthapana 1949). | Galat kyun: High Court Jodhpur me hai, RPSC nahi; Jaipur aur Udaipur me RPSC ka mukhyalaya nahi hai. | Concept: Har sansthan ka apna mukhyalaya hota hai — High Court aur RPSC alag jagah hain. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: RPSC = Ajmer; High Court = Jodhpur. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.

question: Gram Sabha me kaun shamil hota hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Gram Sabha me gaon ke sabhi matdata shamil hote hain; yah gaon ki sabse badi sabha hai. | Galat kyun: Sarpanch, Pradhan aur Panch akele Gram Sabha nahi hain — ve iske padadhikari hain. | Concept: Gram Sabha = sabhi matdata; Gram Panchayat = chune hue sadasya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sabha = sab; Panchayat = chune hue. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md; NCERT Class 11 Political Science.

question: Anuchhed 370 kab nishprabhavi hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 5 Aug 2019 ko Anuchhed 370 nishprabhavi hua aur J&K ka vishesh darja samapt hua. | Galat kyun: 15 Aug 2019 galat tareekh hai (ghoshna 5 Aug ko hui); 26 Jan 1950 aur 1 Nov 1956 alag aitihasik tareekhein hain. | Concept: 5 Aug 2019 = Art 370 ka ant; J&K do kendra shasit pradeshon me bata. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 5 Aug 2019 — 370 gaya. | Source: notes/05_polity_rajasthan.md.
